name: boot-identity.txt
command: date -u; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id /proc/uptime /etc/prd_info.ini; getconf CLK_TCK; systemctl --version; for x in systemd-analyze journalctl dlogutil dmesg; do command -v "$x"; done; systemctl show -p FirmwareTimestampMonotonic -p LoaderTimestampMonotonic -p KernelTimestamp -p UserspaceTimestampMonotonic -p FinishTimestampMonotonic; true

name: unit-timestamps.txt
command:
set -eu
set -f
units=$(systemctl list-units --all --no-legend --plain | awk '{print $1}'); systemctl show -p Id -p Type -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p After -p Before -p Requires -p Wants -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic -p InactiveExitTimestampMonotonic -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic -p InactiveEnterTimestampMonotonic -p NRestarts -- $units

name: boot-dependencies.txt
command: systemctl --no-pager list-units --all; systemctl show AT-HUB.service app-boot-manager.service webappservice.service wrt-service.service display-manager.service sdbd.service -p Id -p Type -p After -p Before -p Wants -p Requires -p ExecStart -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic -p Result; systemctl cat AT-HUB.service app-boot-manager.service; command -v systemd-analyze >/dev/null && systemd-analyze critical-chain; true

name: startup-state.txt
command: for k in db/appfw/home_appid db/appfw/startup_appid db/appfw/booting_appid_backup db/menu/smart_hub/ontvsetting/auto_start memory/appfw/current_fullscreen_appid; do vconftool get "$k"; done; cat /opt/minimal-saver/last-boot.log; ps -eo pid,ppid,uid,comm; ls -ld /run/log/journal /var/log/journal /opt/var/log /opt/etc/*boot* /opt/etc/parseinfo.sh 2>/dev/null; dlogutil --help 2>&1 | head -n 65; true
